description: Staff dashboards: Serveur (waiter), Cuisine (kitchen), and LoginPage. These three views cover the full real-time order-flow from reception to service. Depends on FEAT-002 (infrastructure) and FEAT-003 is independent — these dashboards do not import client components.
steps: Create src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: login form with email/password fields (FR/EN labels). On submit calls Firebase signInWithEmailAndPassword. On success, reads the user's AppUser doc from /users/{uid} to get role, sets authStore.setUser and authStore.setFirebaseUser, then navigates to the role's dashboard (/serveur, /cuisine, or /admin). Shows error message on wrong credentials. Shows <Spinner> during loading. Bilingual toggle at top-right via <LanguageSwitcher>. Restaurant branding (logo text 'Place de la Victoire', tagline).

Create src/components/serveur/OrderCard.tsx: card showing one order's details for the waiter — clientPrenom, table number, list of items with quantities, total price, createdAt formatted as relative time ('il y a 2 min'). Shows current <Badge> status. Framer Motion `layout` animation so cards reorder smoothly as statuses change.

Create src/components/serveur/OrderActions.tsx: action buttons for a given order status — if PENDING: 'Valider' (green) + 'Rejeter' (red, opens modal to enter rejectedReason), if READY: 'Marquer SERVI', if SERVED: 'Paiement encaissé' (marks PAID). Each button calls updateOrderStatus() from firestore.ts. Disable buttons while update is in flight (loading state).

Create src/components/serveur/TableCard.tsx: table summary card showing table number, zone badge (salle/paillote/jardin with different background colors), current active order count, table status (libre/occupée). Clicking it filters orders displayed below to only that table.

Create src/pages/serveur/ServeurDashboard.tsx: main waiter view. Subscribes via useOrders({ role: 'serveur' }) to ALL non-PAID, non-REJECTED orders (statuses: PENDING, VALIDATED, IN_PREPARATION, READY, SERVED). Layout: left panel = list of tables (TableCard components, 2-column grid), right panel = orders for selected table (or all orders if no table selected). Orders grouped by statut with count badges on group headers. Each order shows <OrderCard> + <OrderActions>. NEW orders (PENDING) appear with a Framer Motion slide-in animation from top + a brief pulsing border. Sound notification: play a soft beep (new Audio('/notification.mp3').play()) when a new PENDING order arrives — guard with user-gesture check (only play if user has interacted with page). Create public/notification.mp3 as a silent placeholder (note in findings that a real .mp3 must be added). Top bar: staff name, logout button, language switcher, live clock.

Create src/components/cuisine/TimerSelector.tsx: component for kitchen to set estimated prep time. Shows quick-select buttons: 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 minutes. Plus a free-text input for custom minutes (number, min 1, max 120). On select/confirm calls a callback prop onSelect(minutes: number). Styled prominently for quick tap on a tablet.

Create src/components/cuisine/TicketCard.tsx: kitchen ticket card styled like a physical receipt — white card with dashed border, table number large at top, clientPrenom, items list in large text for readability, timestamp. If status is IN_PREPARATION shows the remaining time as a simple text countdown (not the animated ring — kitchen display is simpler). Action buttons: if VALIDATED → 'Commencer' (sets IN_PREPARATION + opens TimerSelector to pick minutes), if IN_PREPARATION → 'PRÊT !' (sets READY). Framer Motion `layout` for reorder animation.

Create src/components/cuisine/KanbanBoard.tsx: two-column layout — 'En attente' column (VALIDATED orders) and 'En préparation' column (IN_PREPARATION orders). Each column shows <TicketCard> components. Count badge on each column header. Accepts orders array as prop. When a ticket moves columns, Framer Motion `AnimatePresence` handles enter/exit.

Create src/pages/cuisine/CuisineDashboard.tsx: kitchen view. Subscribes via useOrders({ role: 'cuisine' }) to VALIDATED and IN_PREPARATION orders. Renders <KanbanBoard>. Top bar: 'Cuisine' title, logout, language switcher. Sound notification on new VALIDATED order (same pattern as ServeurDashboard). No table filter needed — kitchen sees all tickets. Orders sorted by createdAt ASC (oldest first = highest priority).
acceptance_criteria: LoginPage renders without errors; form submission triggers signInWithEmailAndPassword (verifiable by build — runtime Firebase call acceptable to fail in preview without real credentials)
ServeurDashboard and CuisineDashboard render without errors when orders array is empty
KanbanBoard renders correctly with mock order props in two columns
TimerSelector renders all 5 quick-select buttons plus free-text input
